P, K = map(int, input().split())
visitedFlag = [False] * 1000000
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def depthFirstSearch(current):
    if visitedFlag[current]:
        return
    visitedFlag[current] = True
    depthFirstSearch((current * K) % P)

totalWays = 1
if K == 1:
    totalWays = (totalWays * P) % MOD
for i in range(1, P):
    if not visitedFlag[i]:
        depthFirstSearch(i)
        totalWays = (totalWays * P) % MOD

print(totalWays)
